business.description: Ekennis Software Services Limited is a technology-driven company focused on delivering innovative, scalable, and customer-centric digital solutions across IT solutions, web and e-commerce development, enterprise applications, ERP consulting, software integrations, and technology-enabled business solutions. Myperfectpack, a technology-enabled printing and packaging brand of the company, offers customised packaging with No Minimum Order Quantity (NO MOQ) solutions.

outlook.statement: Focus going forward is clear: strengthening operations, improving efficiencies, building sustainable revenues, enhancing customer experience, exercising financial discipline, and creating long-term value for all stakeholders.

The Company continues to focus on strengthening its business model and improving profitability. During the current financial year, the Company has expanded its service portfolio by introducing AI-assisted design creation and conversion of AI-generated designs into professional print-ready vector formats. This value-added service is expected to improve overall margins while creating an additional and scalable revenue stream. The Company aims to achieve a stronger balance between product sales and high-margin service offerings, supporting sustainable revenue growth and improved profitability.

Company aims to strengthen market position and create meaningful value for stakeholders while contributing to advancement of industry verticals through customer-centric approach, continuous improvement, skill development, innovation, and process enhancements
The company is steadily progressing in its endeavour for alternate source of energy and is hopeful that improvements will be made going forward.
